content: Video piracy protection tiers: full DRM (Widevine and FairPlay) blocks download and screen-record at player level (around 90 percent effective, Netflix-grade) but costly and complex; dynamic per-user watermarking (email or IP overlay) is a cheaper deterrent that traces leaks to the account; tokenized and expiring URLs plus domain restriction plus geo-block are lightweight complements. Budget managed-DRM video hosts start around 10 euros per month (Kinescope) vs around 49 dollars per month (VdoCipher), a relevant cost anchor for a solo creator v1 decision (full DRM likely overkill for v1, watermark plus domain-lock is the pragmatic default).
